turns.textJp: 大人気じゃん……！！

turns.textJp: よーっし、この調子でもうちょっと色々去年のこと探ってみよう！

ko_hasuko.speaker: 카호

en_idolst.speaker: Kaho

Yes, the two of them certainly have no shortage of anecdotes.

ko_hasuko.speaker: 사야카

en_idolst.speaker: Sayaka
en_idolst.text: There's no shortage of stories about those two, so I'm sure we'll be able to find lots of things in no time!
